headline: Lacerte says BILL's underwriting wait fell from three hours to about 12 minutes
body: BILL CEO René Lacerte said on the earnings call that its AI agents save teams more than 1,400 hours per month. The risk team's three agents, a suite called Robin, send each underwriting case to the right underwriter and pull the customer's data into a summary.
note: These are BILL's own figures from its earnings call. Lenders would need to test the same speed gain on their own underwriting decisions.

evidence.text: teams more than 1,400 hours per month, which is equivalent to about eight full-time employees, BILL CEO and Founder René Lacerte said Thursday (Nov. 5)
during the company’s first quarter fiscal year 2027 earnings call
Lacerte zeroed in on BILL’s three agents that work together as a suite called Robin to handle underwriting cases.
Robin sends each case to the right underwriter, pulls the customer’s data into a summary and provides a one-click link to make a decision.
“As a result, each case and customer wait time now takes about 12 minutes instead of three hours,” Lacerte said.
